description_en: Queries the detailed log information of real-time data ingestion tasks for a cluster
description_zh: 查询集群实时数据接入任务的日志详细信息
name: DescribeApsActionLogs

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of the cluster. The cluster must be of the Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口查看集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html接口查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the logs. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 日志的开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the logs. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

When you query logs, the end time must be later than the start time, and the time span between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
日志的结束时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。

查询日志时，结束时间需大于开始时间，且与开始时间最大间隔不超过30天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data link task
parameters.name: workload_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword for the query. Fuzzy matching is applied during log query
parameters.help_zh: 查询的关键字。在日志查询时模糊匹配
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The task stage. Valid values:

StructureMigrate: Schema migration.
FullDataSync: Full data synchronization.
IncrementalSync: Incremental data synchronization.

If you do not specify this parameter, logs of all task stages are queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
任务阶段。取值：

StructureMigrate：结构迁移。
FullDataSync：全量同步。
IncrementalSync：增量同步。

未指定该参数时，默认查询所有的任务阶段
parameters.name: stage

parameters.help_en:
The log type. Separate multiple log types with commas (,). Valid values:

INFO: Information.
WARN: Warning.
ERROR: Error.

If you do not specify this parameter, logs of all types are queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
日志类型。多个日志类型用英文逗号（,）分隔。取值：

INFO：信息。
WARN：警告。
ERROR：错误。

未指定该参数时，默认查询所有的日志类型
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30 (default)
50
100
parameters.help_zh:
每页的记录数。取值：

30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码。取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的正整数。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial
